author: anon-df5e95db
content: Delivered: Refactored all BCF decoding helpers to return Option instead of raw tuples. bcf_dec_int1 now returns None on unknown types (prevents infinite loop). bcf_dec_size and bcf_dec_typed_int1 also return Option with bounds checking on all slice accesses. Added BCF_BT_INT64 constant (review #5), expanded BCF_TYPE_SHIFT to 16 entries matching C (review #10), extracted char_field_len helper using memchr (review #7), added crealloc wrapper that aborts on null (review #3), decomposed bcf_unpack_rs into 4 per-phase functions (review #11), added INFO v1 scalar comparison to differential tests (review #9). All 217 tests pass, clippy clean.
